``` ### Why it looks like this | Step | What changed in v6 | What the code does | |------|-------------------|--------------------| | **CSS** | Still a plain stylesheet, unchanged. | Loads the default MapLibre styles (sprites, glyphs, etc.). | | **Script tag** | v6 removed the UMD bundle; only an **ESM** (`.mjs`) file exists. | `type="module"` tells the browser to treat the script as an ES module. | | **Import** | No default export any more (`import maplibregl from …` no longer works). | We use a **namespace import** (`import * as maplibregl`) or you can import only the pieces you need (`import { Map, NavigationControl } from …`). | | **Worker URL** | The CDN ESM build automatically resolves the worker via `import.meta.url`. | No extra `setWorkerUrl()` call is required. | | **Version pinning** | A major version bump (v5 → v6) silently broke pages that used `@latest`. | The URL explicitly pins to `6.15.0` (or any other v6.x you prefer). | | **Serving** | Modules can’t be loaded from `file://` in most browsers. | Open the file via a local web server (`python -m http.server`, `live-server`, etc.) or host it on any static-file server. | ### Quick test 1. Save the snippet above as `index.html`. 2. Serve it (e.g. `python -m http.server 8000` from the same folder). 3. Open `http://localhost:8000` in a modern browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari). You should see a world map centered on `[0, 0]` with zoom-in/out buttons. That’s it – no npm, no bundler, just plain HTML and a CDN. 🎉
